jobs.name: Listing correspondence
jobs.prompt: Handle the user's correspondence with listing agents. The pre-run script has already recorded new replies and found the contact requests and replies that need you. Follow the contact skill: run its work command and handle every listing it lists, then stop. Nobody reads your final response. Anything the user must know goes through the contact skill's ask or tell commands.

jobs.name: Listing search
jobs.prompt: Above is the report of this hour's apartment search. If it lists listings that wait for a judgment of the must-haves, judge them as the search skill's section "Judging must-haves" says, and keep going with the next batch from pending until none waits. Do not contact anyone and do not change any settings. End with one line saying how many listings you judged.
